fields.headline: An acquisition is a *change event*.
fields.detail: Agreed sale to Bending Spoons for $3.68B, all cash. Expected to close early 2027.
fields.advice: Skip announcement-day blasts. Reach out when customers feel the change.

fields.caption: Bending Spoons' agreed price for Mailchimp. Intuit paid *$12B* in 2021.
